# CopilotForge - Organisation Tailoring

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-port.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Turn an organisation profile into a recommended edition and maturity archetype, a scaled programme, an ownership map and a transformation pack.

- **Layer:** spanning
- **Lead role:** Transformation Architect
- **Plugin name:** `copilotforge-organisation-tailoring`

| Skill | Status | Lifecycle | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| [`ai-profile-intake`](skills/ai-profile-intake/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover | Creates or validates an organisation profile - size, business units, regulatory context, Microsoft estate, current AI use, knowledge, governance, adoption and delivery capability - by short interview or from a file, capturing only what tailoring needs and marking unknowns. Use when someone asks for help with an AI programme and no profile exists, when a profile file is supplied, or when circumstances have changed since the last pack. |
| [`edition-and-archetype`](skills/edition-and-archetype/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision | Applies the CopilotForge tailoring rules to a validated organisation profile to recommend an edition (starter, scale or enterprise), an assurance overlay and a maturity archetype, citing the rule id behind each, reporting emerging signals and explaining the result to the sponsor before any pack is built. Use when a profile is ready, when a sponsor asks why they got a lighter or heavier programme, or when circumstances change. |
| [`ownership-map`](skills/ownership-map/SKILL.md) | draft | Mobilise | Produces a role-based ownership map for an AI programme from declared roles only - the accountable role for each engaged department and each pack artefact, named owners only where the organisation has declared them, and the capability and capacity gaps to close. Use when a transformation pack needs owners, when a sponsor asks who will do this work, or when nobody can say who owns adoption, governance or agents. |
| [`transformation-pack`](skills/transformation-pack/SKILL.md) | draft | Discover, Envision, Mobilise, Enable, Deliver, Assure, Launch, Measure, Scale, Improve | Orchestrates a tailored AI transformation pack from a confirmed profile - assessment, target operating model, adoption and Champions programmes, CoE, opportunity process, agent delivery, governance, roadmap, ownership map, templates and success measures - at the depth the edition sets, and explains material changes on refresh. Use when an organisation asks for help adopting Copilot, scaling agents or setting up an AI CoE. |
